# Start effect (once, flag COLDWAR_AFG_initialized): start spirits, revolt meter, dynamic modifiers.
# Called from the country history and, as a fallback, from on_startup and on_monthly_AFG.
COLDWAR_AFG_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = AFG
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_AFG_initialize"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_aid_dependent_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_aid_dependent_1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_drought_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_drought_1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_ten_per_cent_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_ten_per_cent_1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_paralysed_jirga } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_paralysed_jirga }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_pashtunistan_question } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_pashtunistan_question }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_article_24_feud } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_article_24_feud }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_arsenal } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_arsenal }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt = 5 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_supporter_cut = 0 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_state_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_economy_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_army_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_modifier }
		COLDWAR_AFG_update_revolt = yes
		hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_AFG_open_balance = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_AFG_open_reach = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_open_reach_tt
	hidden_effect = {

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_reach_open
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_reach_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_reach_modifier } }
		COLDWAR_AFG_update_reach = yes
	}
}

# Foreign Policy root and trunk: the Moscow-Washington balance starts at 0.

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_balance_open } }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_balance_open

		}
	}

# Input: COLDWAR_AFG_reach_change (signed). The only way to change State Reach; clamped 0-100.
COLDWAR_AFG_change_reach = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_reach } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_reach = 25 } }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_reach = COLDWAR_AFG_reach_change }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach min = 0 max = 100 }
	COLDWAR_AFG_update_reach = yes
}

COLDWAR_AFG_update_reach = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_tax = 0.10 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_cons = 0.06 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_tax = 0.06 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_cons = 0.04 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_tax = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_cons = 0.02 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_tax = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_rc_cons = 0 }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Input: COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_change (signed). The only way to change the Countryside in Revolt; clamped 0-100.
COLDWAR_AFG_change_revolt = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_change }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt min = 0 max = 100 }
	COLDWAR_AFG_update_revolt = yes
}

# Bands 25 / 40 / 60 / 80: one spirit; Mountain Front from 40; The Exodus begins at 60.
# After The Countryside Pacified or A Negotiated Peace the band spirit stays away until the revolt reaches 40 again.
COLDWAR_AFG_update_revolt = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 25 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_war_over } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_1 NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 1 } } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_2 NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 2 } } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_3 NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 3 } } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_4 NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 4 } } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_4 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 1 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 2 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_2 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 3 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_3 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_band = 4 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_4 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_spirit_4 }
	# Mountain Front (state modifier, idempotent)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_war_over } }
		1153 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		1154 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		1207 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		412 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		409 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
	}
	else = {
		1153 = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		1154 = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		1207 = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		412 = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
		409 = { if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_mountain_front } } }
	}
	# The Exodus begins at 60
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees < 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = 1 } }

# Input: COLDWAR_AFG_refugee_change (signed steps). The Exodus: steps 0-3.
COLDWAR_AFG_change_refugees = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = COLDWAR_AFG_refugee_change }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_refugees min = 0 max = 3 }
	COLDWAR_AFG_update_exodus = yes

# The Exodus values by step; halved for every neighbour that hosts the refugees (Pakistan, Iran).
COLDWAR_AFG_update_exodus = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult = 1 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = PER PER = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_hosting_refugees } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult = 0.5 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_stab = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_pop = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_recr = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_stab = -0.02 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_pop = -0.05 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_recr = -0.05 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_stab = -0.04 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_pop = -0.10 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_recr = -0.10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees = 3 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_stab = -0.06 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_pop = -0.15 } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_recr = -0.15 } }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_stab = COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_pop = COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ex_recr = COLDWAR_AFG_ex_mult }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_modifier } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_refugees < 1 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_modifier } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_exodus_modifier } }
}

# The Geneva Accords take effect (all three guarantors signed).
COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_signed = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_change = -20 }
	COLDWAR_AFG_change_revolt = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_in_force
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } PAK = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PER PER = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } PER = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAU SAU = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } SAU = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI CHI = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } CHI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter } } ENG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.708 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_withdrawing } } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.709 } } }
	}
}

# Monthly pulse (on_monthly_AFG).
COLDWAR_AFG_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = 0 }
		# The Great Drought: +0.50 revolt, -0.5 State Reach
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_drought_1 has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_drought_2 has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_drought_3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = 0.50 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_reach } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_reach_change = -0.5 } COLDWAR_AFG_change_reach = yes }
		}
		# Soviet contingent: level read from the Soviet Union (its own variable); +1 revolt per level, reinforcement -1 / -2
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_limited_contingent country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = SOV.COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -2 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ct_def = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_ct_def = 0.05 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 0 } NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level < 1 } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_modifier } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_modifier } }
		# Supporters of the resistance (their own flags), capped at 3 a month
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 0 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_cyclone } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_isi } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PER PER = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_tehran } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 0.50 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAU SAU = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_saudi } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI CHI = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_china } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 0.50 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_mi6 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = 0.50 } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in min = 0 max = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_keep = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_keep = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter_cut }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_keep min = 0.25 max = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_keep }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_in }
		# Drifts of the peace chain and of the Geneva Accords
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_ceasefire_drift } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_reconciliation_drift } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_geneva_accords } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -1 } }
		# Calm: stability above 60% and no supporter active
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_stability > 0.6
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_cyclone }
						PAK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_isi }
						PER = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_tehran }
						SAU = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_saudi }
						CHI = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_china }
						ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_mi6 }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -0.50 }
		}
		# State Reach calms the countryside: -0.25 from 50, -0.5 from 75
		if = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_reach check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -0.5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_AFG_reach check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_reach value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month = -0.25 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_change = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_month }
		# the war returns as a national war once the revolt has climbed back to 40 (checked before the monthly change)
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_war_over check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_revolt value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_war_over }
		COLDWAR_AFG_change_revolt = yes
		COLDWAR_AFG_restore_bound_spirits = yes
		COLDWAR_AFG_offer_reconcile = yes
	}
}

# Change of government: a new direction may be chosen; bound spirits return with their party.
# Called from on_ruling_party_change / on_government_change and after every power focus (a change between two
# parties of the same MD outlook does not fire the native hooks).
COLDWAR_AFG_sync_politics = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_direction_chosen
		COLDWAR_AFG_restore_bound_spirits = yes
	}
}

# Bound spirits (cancel while their party is out of office) return when it governs again; also checked monthly.
COLDWAR_AFG_restore_bound_spirits = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_free_press_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_free_press }
				OR = {
					western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
					western_liberals_are_in_power = yes
					nationalist_fascist_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_free_press
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_jafari_courts_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_jafari_courts }
				OR = {
					emerging_hardline_shiite_are_in_power = yes
					emerging_moderate_shiite_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_jafari_courts
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_liberation_front_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_liberation_front }
				OR = {
					nationalist_right_wing_populists_are_in_power = yes
					salafist_kingdom_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_liberation_front
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_nrp_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_nrp }
				OR = {
					emerging_autocracy_are_in_power = yes
					nationalist_military_junta_are_in_power = yes
					emerging_reactionaries_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_nrp
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_palace_secretariat_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_palace_secretariat }
				OR = {
					nationalist_monarchists_are_in_power = yes
					western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
					western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
					neutrality_neutral_autocracy_are_in_power = yes
					neutrality_neutral_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_palace_secretariat
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_party_list_jirga_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_party_list_jirga }
				OR = {
					nationalist_monarchists_are_in_power = yes
					western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
					western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
					neutrality_neutral_autocracy_are_in_power = yes
					neutrality_neutral_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
				}
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_party_list_jirga
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sharia_faculty_earned
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_sharia_faculty }
				neutrality_neutral_muslim_brotherhood_are_in_power = yes
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_sharia_faculty
		}
	}
}

# Weekly money (MD weekly units, recomputed from the current GDP every weekly budget pass).
# Called from calculate_additional_income_rate and calculate_additional_expense_rate (00_money_system.txt, COLDWAR patch).
COLDWAR_AFG_calculate_weekly_income = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = AFG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_saudi_benefactor country_exists = SAU }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = SAU.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_gas_commission country_exists = SOV }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = SOV.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0015 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_helmand_delta country_exists = USA }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = USA.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0005 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_poppy_programme country_exists = USA }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = USA.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00015 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_AFG_land_poppy_eradicate } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_iranian_credit country_exists = PER has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_iranian_credit_grant }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = PER.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00012 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_indian_aid country_exists = RAJ }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = RAJ.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0026 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_paktia_project country_exists = GER }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = GER.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0008 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_parwan_canal country_exists = CHI }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = CHI.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0017 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_chinese_credit country_exists = CHI }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = CHI.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0028 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_saudi_loan country_exists = SAU }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = SAU.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_kuwait_fund country_exists = SAU }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = SAU.gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		add_to_variable = { additional_income_rate = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_income }
	}
}

COLDWAR_AFG_calculate_weekly_expense = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_expense = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = AFG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_initialized }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_wheat_repay }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0001 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_iranian_credit_repay }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00012 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
		}
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_expense }
	}
}

# Partner and supporter countries: their own weekly share (of THEIR GDP). Runs in their own scope from their own
# weekly budget pass, never from Afghanistan. Transfers to Afghanistan are booked again as Afghan income.
COLDWAR_AFG_calculate_partner_weekly_expense = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_advisory_mission_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0004 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_limited_contingent_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0001 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 1 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra = 0.00005 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 2 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra = 0.00005 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_extra } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_brigades_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00003 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_chinese_rural_aid_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.002 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_pakistani_sanctuary_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.016 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_iranian_brotherhood_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_isi_pipeline_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00003 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_saudi_benefactor_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_shia_patronage_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_gas_commission_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_officer_training_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0002 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }

		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }

		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG AFG = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_AFG_land_poppy_eradicate } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 2 } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {

		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}

		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_kuwait_fund_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_cyclone }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0025 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}

		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00002 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_tehran }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_saudi }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00006 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_china }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.002 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_mi6 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.0002 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_pak_refugee_host }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.00002 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_per_refugee_host }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.015 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part = 0.001 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_AFG_weekly_part }
	}
	add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_AFG_partner_weekly_expense }
}

# ---- Bilateral offers (AFG scope only; partners are addressed through events) ----
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.101 days = 1 } }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_open value = 1 days = 90 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_party = ruling_party }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_refused
	}

# Monthly and after every answer: the AFG spirit returns when the pair is clear again; partners are asked by a
# hidden event in their own scope. One-time payments are never charged again (_paid flags).
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_advisory_mission } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_paid } }
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_soviet_advisory_mission_paid }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_balance_open } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_AFG_bop value = -0.10 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_AFG_bop_moscow } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_bop_shadow = -0.10 } }
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_soviet_advisory_mission
	}
}
COLDWAR_AFG_offer_treaty_of_friendship_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_AFG_offer_treaty_of_friendship_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_treaty_of_friendship } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_treaty_of_friendship_paid } }
			hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_treaty_of_friendship_paid }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_balance_open } add_power_balance_value = { id = COLDWAR_AFG_bop value = -0.10 tooltip_side = COLDWAR_AFG_bop_moscow } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_bop_shadow = -0.10 } }
		}
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_treaty_of_friendship
	}
}

		limit = { COLDWAR_AFG_offer_limited_contingent_active = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_limited_contingent } }

# ---- Afghan War: decisions of other countries (each in its own scope) ----
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_cyclone = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_cyclone
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_cyclone_patron } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_cyclone_patron }
}
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_isi = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_isi
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_frontier_militancy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_frontier_militancy }
}
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_tehran = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_tehran
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_tehran_patron } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_tehran_patron }
}
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_saudi = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_saudi
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_saudi_match } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_saudi_match }
}
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_china = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_china
}
COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_mi6 = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_mi6
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_mi6_teams } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_mi6_teams }
}
# Soviet scope: the Afghan Syndrome follows the contingent level; at level 0 it stays for a year.
COLDWAR_AFG_update_syndrome = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_3 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_3 }
	else = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_AFG_afghan_syndrome_1 days = 365 } }
}

# Soviet scope: withdrawal, one level every 90 days (decision Begin Withdrawal or the Geneva Accords).
COLDWAR_AFG_begin_withdrawal = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AFG_withdrawal_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_withdrawing
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.707 days = 90 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG } AFG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.706 } } }
	}
}
